body.title: Add inline comments as drafts
body.summary: Selecting text in one block of a markdown document offers a round comment button that marks the passage and opens a thread card with a field. An added comment is a draft with a quote, section, prefix and suffix. Drafts are sent with the decision, cleared only on a clean result, removable, and kept in the webview's saved state per artifact.
acceptanceChecks: A selection in one block makes a draft with its anchor; a selection across blocks, in the Feedback section or cutting a mark offers no button
Every draft is posted with the decision
Drafts are cleared on a successful result, kept on a failed one or one with commentsError, and restored when the shell is rebuilt
Comment and quote text are set as text

tests.name: docs review shell: selecting text in one block and adding a comment makes a draft with a quote, section, prefix and suffix; a selection across blocks, in the Feedback section or cutting an existing mark offers no button
docs review shell: the three buttons post one docs-decision with every draft and the whole-document comment, are disabled until the result arrives, and feedback with no comment posts nothing
docs review shell: drafts are cleared on a successful result, kept on a failed one or one with commentsError, and restored from the saved state when the shell is rebuilt
